decisions.reason: As a glazed industrial sectional door close to the firm's core range, it likely has modest carrying cost and strategic value in maintaining a broad compliant offering, so the option value of keeping it still outweighs the case for withdrawal.

The glazed insulated industrial sectional door fits the firm's strength in customized, regulation-sensitive industrial access solutions and likely extends an established platform, making continued retention more attractive than redeploying resources.

Although another glazed industrial sectional door variant raises some overlap risk and the firm has alternative development options, it still supports the one-source portfolio and can be kept unless clearer evidence emerges that demand is too weak.
